[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]There's a path leading from the base[XENO:n ]
of Machine God Index Finger to the foot of the Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
This is the security key to the door that seals the path.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

We who live in the village don't have any[XENO:n ]
need for it, but it will be invaluable to you.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]We're in your debt. Linada-san.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:act act=EVT_EXT3 ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]Shulk, Fiorung... Take care on your journey.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Linada-san, thank you for everything.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
